The status endpoint only sets a task to Completed and records the Completion Date. A Completed task cannot be changed back. The frontend shows the new status only after the backend confirms the change.","business_value":"Users can track finished work and the report counts of Completed tasks stay accurate.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with status Open exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed","then":"the backend stores the status Completed and the task list shows the task with status Completed"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task fails in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the task list still shows the previous status and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is pending and the backend has not responded yet","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"the row still shows the previous status and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is sent for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend processes the request","then":"the backend returns a task not found error and no stored task changes"},{"given":"a status change request is sent with a status value other than Completed (for example Open, In Progress or an unknown value)","when":"the backend validates the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status does not change"},{"given":"a task is marked as Completed","when":"the backend saves the change","then":"the Completion Date field of the task is populated with the time of the change"},{"given":"a task already has status Completed","when":"a status change request with any status other than Completed is sent for it","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status and Completion Date do not change"}],"edge_cases":["A Completed task cannot be changed back to Open or In Progress; open question whether the Completion Date is kept or updated."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["All acceptance criteria are covered by passing automated tests","Backend errors are shown in the frontend without a success state","Code reviewed and merged"]},"fixes":[{"finding":1,"revised_tasks":[{"task_key":"BE-status-change-error-handling","task":{"key_slug":"status-change-error-handling","title":"[BE] Return errors for status change on missing task and invalid status","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Return a task not found error when the task ID does not exist and an invalid input error when the requested status is anything other than Completed (including Open, In Progress and unknown values).
